protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
{
    modelBuilder.Entity<Book>()
        .HasIndex(b => b.Isbn)
        .IsUnique();

    modelBuilder.Entity<Book>()
        .HasOne(b => b.Author)
        .WithMany(a => a.Books)
        .HasForeignKey(b => b.AuthorId)
        .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
}
